records.title: MeLoRA : Probability measures-based low-rank adaptation with Gaussian variational inference
records.reason: The publisher abstract identifies MeLoRA as a probabilistic PEFT method specifically applied to LLMs, with memory-efficient covariance and nearly negligible added inference latency; full-text method/evaluation could not be accessed through the primary ScienceDirect page, so its adaptation-memory and training-cost claims remain unverified.

records.title: Accelerating deep neural networks through stability-aware initial training and density-guided asymptotic filter decay
records.reason: The title describes stability-aware initialization/filter decay for generic deep-network training; it provides no LLM-specific inference or deployment method.

records.title: FP8ApproxLib: An FPGA-based approximate multiplier library for 8-bit floating point
records.reason: FP8ApproxLib’s publisher abstract reports FPGA approximate FP8 multipliers, neural-network inference case studies including LLMs, and lower resource/energy cost; full-text method, numerical tradeoffs and LLM case-study details could not be accessed from the primary ScienceDirect page.

records.title: Exploring KV Cache Quantization in Multimodal Large Language Model Inference
records.reason: This is directly about KV-cache quantization for MLLM inference and is linked to a KV-cache compression paper. The publisher full text was inaccessible; only primary bibliographic/abstract material was available, so method, evaluation setup and limitations were not checked.

records.title: Spatiotemporal Graph Mixture of Experts for Highway Traffic Flow Prediction
records.reason: The paper uses a spatiotemporal graph MoE for highway traffic forecasting; it is task-specific traffic prediction, not LLM inference routing or serving.
